name: computer_use__scroll
description:
Scroll the target pid's focused region by synthesized keystrokes.

Mapping: by='page' → PageDown/PageUp × amount; by='line' → DownArrow/UpArrow × amount. Horizontal variants use Left/Right arrow keys.

Optional element_index + window_id pre-focuses the element before scrolling.

session.description: Optional session id: declares/uses the agent cursor and per-session state for this run. The same id works over MCP, the CLI, or the raw socket, and follows the run across apps/windows. Omit to run cursor-less.
